gen-megrim-poppins: Megrim draws every stroke at a measured, hairline-fine thickness, all angles and distance. Poppins sits beneath it with loose, rounded curves and a sturdy tall lowercase, giving the sharp futurism somewhere comfortable to land.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-manrope: Tilt Neon's tube-like strokes hold a constant width, with a splayed c terminal that gives its big lowercase a glowing swagger. Manrope keeps things friendly beneath it.
gen-gf-unica-one-montserrat: Soft and spacious, this body text lets light into every curve, so lines glide along without a snag. Unica One is the one that grabs attention, with its large lowercase and uniform strokes, while Montserrat is the sans-serif that keeps the eye moving.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-supreme: Supreme lays down a crisp, dense band of text, its curves held open rather than curled shut. Supreme over a full page stays sharp and steady, a firm counterweight to the bookish, nostalgic quirks of Mystery Quest above.
gen-gf-wallpoet-montserrat: Wallpoet stamps its tall lowercase onto the page with gaps of paper showing between the letters. Montserrat is the plain sans that skims by, effortless.
gen-tourney-poppins: Athletic and bold, Tourney stretches its chunky small letters out with wide tracking, every stroke cut to a single width. And Poppins answers it with rounded, unhurried curves and a sturdy tall lowercase, which takes the pressure off.
gen-audiowide-archivo: Audiowide's y has a tail as thick as its arm, and its glyphs sit apart like tiles with wide grout. Archivo feels more editorial next to it, its outward-opening curves and tall x-height warming up the techy shine.
gen-eater-fs-familjen-grotesk: Dark and a bit aggressive, Eater has the worn, restrained thick-thin play of an old wooden stamp, with wide gaps between letters. But Familjen Grotesk is lively and tall in the lowercase, and its half-finished bowls give the sans a loose energy that keeps the menace from taking over.
gen-gf-autour-one-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Pilcrow Rounded packs its letters tight, with big counters and curves that never quite close. Autour One is the expressive, bold one that rounds into its shapes without any hairline shifts, and the sans body simply stays warm and readable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-hind: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, its c tips never edging toward each other. Hind slips in beside it with lowercase almost as tall as the capitals, making the sans-serif feel like a quieter relative.
